extras.zh: UTXOSwap 官方文档（LP Token 一节）给出交易结构：Pool Cell 的 lock 是 “sequencer proxy lock”，type 是 pool_type（主网 0xc70a8b00…3c98，测试网 0x5b9228b1…8735）。本 code_hash 是链上 Pool Cell 实际使用的 lock；角色由文档结构推断，未向维护方确认。
extras.en: The official UTXOSwap docs (LP Token section) describe the tx layout: the Pool Cell lock is the "sequencer proxy lock" and its type is pool_type (mainnet 0xc70a8b00…3c98, testnet 0x5b9228b1…8735). This code_hash is the lock the on-chain Pool Cell actually uses; the role is inferred from that layout and unconfirmed with the maintainer.

extras.zh: 同一交易里池资产 cell 的 “pool controlled lock”（主网 0x393df335…9a88，测试网 0x75ac9069…260e）不在清单中，未收录。
extras.en: The "pool controlled lock" of pool asset cells in the same txs (mainnet 0x393df335…9a88, testnet 0x75ac9069…260e) is not in the list and was not added.
